config.representation: Fresh Morgan 2048-bit molecular input; randomly initialized shared 256/64 hidden layers
config.tasks: Four official TDI booleans plus direct pIC50, TDI pIC50 and paired difference for each enzyme. Potencies are floored at the assay boundary 4 before continuous auxiliary learning; missing measurements are masked, never imputed as inactive.
config.loss: D6 BCE + 0.3 * mean other-enzyme BCE + 0.2 * mean per-task standardized continuous MSE; AdamW lr .002 decay .001 dropout .15 full batch 100 epochs
config.threshold_policy: Maximize inner OOF bootstrap mean MCC; no positive-count constraint
config.excluded_inputs: All prior trained models, encoders, predictions, thresholds and submission counts; only source molecule and assay tables
config.status: Foundational cross-enzyme learning test; no upload, no historical blend

operating_points.note: Full-development threshold; pooled OOF fit is an optimistic MCC estimate
